d: Mokama vidhayak Anant Singh ki beti ki shadi ko lekar bihar ki siyasat men bhi charcha ho rahi hai. Anant Singh ne shadi men satta paksh aur vipaksh ke netaon ko aamantrit karne ki bat kahi hai. ab is nyote ko lekar RJD neta Mrityunjay Tiwari ki pratikriya samne aaee hai. aakhir Anant Singh ke shadi ke nimantran par Mrityunjay Tiwari ne kya kaha? kya shadi ke bahane bihar ke rajnitik galiyaron men bhi charcha tej hai? sunie unka pura bayana.
